blocker.message: Six no-split whole-goal entailments introduce C stack data_at resources only in their consequent. Witnesses 10, 21, 43 and 60 require &break_pc and &continue_pc cells; witness 48 additionally requires &fid, &pc, &temp and &continue_pc; witness 53 requires &fid, &pc, &temp and &break_pc. Their antecedents contain only a resolved emitter-plan resource and pure facts. The duplicated disjuncts have the same defect. A heap holding only the emitter/output representation, with these stack addresses unallocated, satisfies the antecedent and cannot satisfy the consequent. These are false whole goals, not failed aggressive splits.
blocker.repair_boundary: Repair internal which-implies annotations: retain/read all C locals used only on the right also on the left, with their unchanged values (e.g. explicit data_at cells or suitable left-hand scalar facts that cause QCP to retain those cells). Preserve all function contracts, runtime and model meanings. Regenerate VCs and verify the bridge/resources are present in both sides. No public axiom or weakened postcondition can repair this structural omission.
